_comment: Pinned Tax-Simulator environment used to generate ts_output/*.out-ts.csv.gz.  Re-pin only deliberately: doing so requires regenerating all TS outputs and re-triaging.
_comment_conda: Create the R environment with: conda create -n tbly-ts -c conda-forge --override-channels <conda_packages>.  Only step 2 (run_ts.py) needs it.
_comment_ts_source_files: Minimal Tax-Simulator source set for the federal calculator; run with the TS clone as the working directory and return_vars = list() set before sourcing.
